ValidationRule.description: To be used on the system admin request when "Idea" or "System Enhancement" is selected as Type, users are required to fill in the "As a", "I want" and "So that" field
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( RecordType.Name=="System Admin Request", OR( ISPICKVAL( Type, 'Idea') ,ISPICKVAL( Type , 'System Enhancement')), OR(ISBLANK( As_a__c ), ISBLANK( I_want__c ), ISBLANK( So_that__c )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please complete the "User Story Format" section
